notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Cast Biogenic Upgrade by paying {4}{G}{G}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Biogenic Upgrade targeting Crystalline Crawler and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Biogenic Upgrade, putting three +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler and then doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target other creatures using Biogenic Upgrade.
